serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Landlord: What?! If the toilet is clogged again plunger is in the storeroom!
You: I-it’s not about that…
Landlord: Listen buddy, I have no time for this.
Landlord: *whispers* Feds showed up! If they find some dead body again I will be forced to lower the rent!
Feds?!
Don’t tell me… {{wi}}Are they here because of the parts I have thrown out?!
Landlord: *whispers* If you want something say it quickly or come to me later!
You: I-I just wanted to ask why they came…
Landlord: *whispers* I Have no idea! They appeared out of nowhere and started asking questions like: ‘how many people live here’? or ‘who has the access to garbage bins’?!
G-garbage bins?!
Landlord: *whispers* Problems come at me one after another…
Landlord: *whispers* And you…
Landlord: Stop wasting my time!
